intent: Measure whether CoCivium's core-out invention rate is outrunning edge-in first useful results, consented discovery and independent stewardship.

CoEBE.meaning: A capable, non-dominated, adaptive plural network with portable identity/work and real exit; operational acceptance must demonstrate edge independence.

CCC.meaning: An indispensable center can dominate identities, meaning, access, permissions, resources or exit; an architecture-risk lens, not an allegation about a specific provider.

CoCCC.meaning: Historical intensified diagnostic of core-control capture; not established as a distinct standard or hierarchy.

ECC.meaning: Fragmented mini-cores or edge capture can also restrict exit; not all decentralization produces equilibrium.

terms.core_out: Create source, protocols, demos, proof, infrastructure then project to recipients.
terms.edge_in: Begin from a voluntary real task, let recipient succeed, contribute corrections, control data, leave or fork, and feed outcomes into core improvements.

hypotheses.name: Public-domain first-use routing is broken
hypotheses.evidence: 2026-10-25: external fetch apex HTTP 404 and www serves an old infrastructure index rather than newcomer task. Same web vantage as yesterday, not two independent networks.
hypotheses.best_test: Owner-controlled review of canonical DNS/TLS and public metadata security, two genuinely independent external networks; compare intended landing source hash and human first-use URL
hypotheses.falsifier: Two independent receivers consistently retrieve the correct current newcomer page and meaningful task from canonical domain.

hypotheses.name: Audience measurement absent or unqualified
hypotheses.evidence: Connected analytics website URL/visitor source not qualified; zeros on unconfigured property do not measure real visitor absence.
hypotheses.best_test: Privacy-safe opt-in aggregate actual landing/first-action/return counts with self/bot exclusions, clear consent and retention.
hypotheses.falsifier: An existing and verified instrumented funnel demonstrates arrivals and task completion rates.

hypotheses.name: Jargon and discovery-to-use friction
hypotheses.evidence: Core repo has many plans and demos; one first-use GitHub source page exists; no external comprehension test established.
hypotheses.best_test: Compare a plain one-task entrance with one specialist path; five consenting newcomers as proposed pilot, keep failures and independent task receipts.
hypotheses.falsifier: Newcomers consistently understand the project and finish a first task quickly regardless of entrance.

hypotheses.name: Insufficient independent distribution and reciprocity
hypotheses.evidence: Publication and messages exist; recipient-side independent uptake, peer contributions and true two-way distribution unqualified.
hypotheses.best_test: One opt-in peer/community with a real need tests a portable, useful artifact; record completed task and reciprocal improvement rather than impressions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Qualified independent use/return/contribution already exists at materially higher level than current verified evidence.

hypotheses.name: Core/edge portability and exit unproven
hypotheses.evidence: Same-provider test/workflow classes; off-provider cold recovery and non-originator independently maintained useful product remain held.
hypotheses.best_test: Independent receiver restores one consent-cleared public-safe work object without X2, ChatGPT and GitHub; proves exact hash, useful result and voluntary exit.
hypotheses.falsifier: Reliable cross-provider recovery and non-originator rebuild already have independently generated readproofs.

hypotheses.name: Edge fragmentation and edge-owned coercion risk
hypotheses.evidence: Multiple specialist entrances may have inconsistent permissions, identity and rights if allowed to become independent mini-cores.
hypotheses.best_test: One user crosses two specialists with explicit scoped consent, imports work, revokes sharing, exits, and retains the right to fork.
hypotheses.falsifier: Measured portable edge-to-edge work with consistent rights and refusal across independent providers.

edge_acceptance_dimensions.target: two independent external networks plus privacy review
edge_acceptance_dimensions.observed: one external web vantage has persistent defect

edge_acceptance_dimensions.target: pilot of five; each can explain project in plain language
one witnessed success then five pilot attempts

edge_acceptance_dimensions.denominator: consenting participants given a correction channel
edge_acceptance_dimensions.target: one independently useful challenge acted upon, with accepted/rejected receipt
off-GitHub/off-ChatGPT restore, no founder privileges needed

edge_acceptance_dimensions.denominator: real user/receiver paths with permission boundaries
edge_acceptance_dimensions.target: negative tests for revocation, no-identity, keyboard and mobile operation

inversion_tests.name: Edge-first design
inversion_tests.question: What does a first-time person need before anyone says CoAll or CoOrbWare?
inversion_tests.test: Offer one existing offline task and compare comprehension against architecture-first path.

inversion_tests.name: No-core recovery
inversion_tests.question: If GitHub, X2 and ChatGPT all become unavailable, does one useful edge still work?
inversion_tests.test: Second steward restores and demonstrates one approved public-safe asset from independent storage.

inversion_tests.name: No-brand usability
inversion_tests.question: Would a useful specialist artifact still be attractive if CoCivium's brand were hidden?
inversion_tests.test: Neutral-labelled equivalent example, opt-in comparison without deceptive identities.

inversion_tests.name: No-account choice
inversion_tests.question: Can a person use, correct, export or leave without a captive central identity?
inversion_tests.test: One complete task and exit through browser-only FOSS demo, verify nothing required server credentials.

inversion_tests.name: No-press amplification
inversion_tests.question: Would broadcasting more visitors to the current domain cause benefit or privacy risk?
inversion_tests.test: Keep blast HELD until domain owner approves public safety and a useful URL; publish fallback GitHub text only.

inversion_tests.name: Edge-to-core corrective pressure
inversion_tests.question: Does independent criticism actually change a source or policy decision?
inversion_tests.test: One independent material issue receives a reproducible test, decision and source-bound correction or reasoned rejection.

offline first-use artifact and tested independent custody
